description: Search intent (informational, navigational, commercial, transactional) with probability for up to 10 keywords (DataForSEO Labs Search Intent). Use it to decide whether a keyword suits an informational, commercial or transactional page. Returns: JSON with keywords, not_classified. PAID: 0.04 USDC per call (USDC on eip155:8453, x402 v2). Requires an x402-capable MCP client that attaches the payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (e.g. createx402MCPClient from @x402/mcp). Without a payment this tool returns a "payment required" result and charges nothing. NOTE: Intent labels come from DataForSEO's classifier. Language coverage is determined by DataForSEO; results for non-English keywords are not guaranteed.

keywords.description: Keywords to look up: 1 to 10 entries, each up to 80 characters / 10 words. Lowercased, duplicates removed.

name: search_intent
